description: List the user's crypto conditional orders (LIMIT / STOP_LOSS / TAKE_PROFIT / TRAILING_STOP, settled via CoW), newest first. Each has status (PENDING_ACTIVATION / ARMED / PUBLISHED / FILLED / CANCELLED / EXPIRED), side, assetSymbol, triggerPrice or trailPercent, raw-unit sellAmount / minBuyAmount, expiresAt and skipReason (why the keeper last did not act, e.g. insufficient_balance). Orders can only be created in the Moneda app.
name: list_conditional_orders
